response.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT AVG(optvolrt) AS b FROM sentimentandfundamentals), combo AS (SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.tradekind AS tradekind, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_opt FROM sentimentandfundamentals s JOIN transactionrecord r ON s.transref = r.transreg JOIN trader t ON r.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), dev AS (SELECT c.transref, c.tradekind, c.avg_opt, c.avg_opt - base.b AS deviation FROM combo c CROSS JOIN base), typed AS (SELECT d.*, AVG(d.deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY d.tradekind) AS type_avg_dev FROM dev d) SELECT tradekind, AVG(avg_opt) AS avg_avg_optvolrt, AVG(deviation) AS avg_deviation, AVG(deviation - type_avg_dev) AS avg_excess FROM typed WHERE tradekind IS NOT NULL AND deviation > type_avg_dev GROUP BY tradekind

assumptions.assumption: The baseline is the plain average of optvolrt over every row in sentimentandfundamentals. Null optvolrt values are ignored.
Combinations with a null average optvolrt have a null deviation. They are ignored in the type averages and fail the comparison, so they are dropped.
